project.name: dr-markdown-md
project.summary: A local Wails desktop markdown editor with a backed editor shell, WYSIWYG/raw/split modes, native file operations, and vendored editor adapters. Targets macOS, Windows and Linux from one binary; only macOS is packaged today. Opened documents are UNTRUSTED input, so the webview is a trust boundary.

notes: Architecture facts were derived from source files, not aspirational planning documents.
